description: This file is a C++ header defining an abstract interface class IVssDatabase, which specifies the methods and data members for interacting with a VSS database, including initialization, updating, querying metadata, and signal handling.

classes.name: IVssDatabase
classes.description: An abstract interface class that provides virtual methods for managing and interacting with a VSS database, including methods for initialization, updates, metadata, and signal access.

methods.name: initJsonTree
methods.description: Initializes the internal JSON data tree from a specified file.

methods.name: updateJsonTree
methods.description: Updates the JSON data tree with data from a KuksaChannel instance.

methods.name: updateMetaData
methods.description: Updates metadata associated with a specific VSS path.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a given VSS path.

methods.name: setSignal
methods.description: Sets a signal value at the specified VSS path and attribute.

methods.name: getSignal
methods.description: Retrieves a signal value from the specified VSS path and attribute.

methods.name: pathExists
methods.description: Checks if a given VSS path exists.

methods.name: pathIsWritable
methods.description: Checks if a given VSS path is writable.

methods.name: pathIsReadable
methods.description: Checks if a given VSS path is readable.

methods.name: pathIsAttributable
methods.description: Checks if an attribute can be associated with a given VSS path.

methods.name: getDatatypeForPath
methods.description: Returns the datatype of a signal at the specified VSS path.

methods.name: getLeafPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of leaf VSS paths under the specified path.

methods.name: checkAndSanitizeType
methods.description: Checks and sanitizes the type of a JSON value according to metadata.
